answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The yarrow is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the canyon. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the hollow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
